purpose: Implement PUT /posts/{id} (update title/content) and DELETE /posts/{id} (soft delete) per the reviewed Task Context. Demonstrates discipline of writing batch plan even when chat planning already covered the same ground (retro action item).
rationale: Review (.review.md) records the Major correction (hard -> soft delete) and its cascading effects.
tdd-endpoint Skill defines the 4-round structure used here.

design_principles.scope: per-batch operational plan, persisted alongside the implementation commit as audit record
design_principles.ownership: AI-drafted from reviewed Task Context, frozen at execution time

operations.content_summary: ALTER TABLE posts ADD COLUMN deleted_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE; (no index for MVP)

Add @SQLRestriction("deleted_at IS NULL") at class level; add private Instant deletedAt field; add getter; add update(title, content, updatedAt) and delete(Instant) domain methods. Existing constructors/getters/withId unchanged.
Update incrementViewCount @Query to add AND p.deletedAt IS NULL (@Modifying @Query is not affected by @SQLRestriction).

Add update(Long id, PostUpdateRequest) and delete(Long id), both @Transactional (non-readOnly). Use findById().orElseThrow(PostNotFoundException::new) then post.update/post.delete then dirty-checking flush.
Add 4 unit tests: update happy/not-found, delete happy/not-found. Verify post.getDeletedAt() and post.getTitle() after method calls.
Add @PutMapping("/{id}") update(...) returning PostResponse and @DeleteMapping("/{id}") with @ResponseStatus(NO_CONTENT) returning void. PathVariable + @Valid @RequestBody PostUpdateRequest.

Add E2E tests: put happy (200 + updated body), put 404, put 400 validation (1 sample), delete 204 + soft-delete verification (subsequent GET 404), delete 404, delete twice (1st 204, 2nd 404), soft-deleted excluded from list (GET totalElements decremented).
Add: put with missing title, missing content, whitespace-only title, oversized title (81 chars), oversized content (5001 chars). Reuse expectValidationFailure() helper.
Full regression: all 23 prior + new = ~33-35 tests must be green.

Bump 'Domain exception -> @ExceptionHandler -> ErrorResponse mapping' from count 1 to count 2 (reuse). Decide: extract Skill now (threshold met) vs hold (pattern was reused without modification — extraction value unclear). Add new monitoring entry for @SQLRestriction soft delete pattern (count 1).
Optionally add: '@SQLRestriction for entity-level soft delete; @Modifying @Query needs explicit filter.' (only if pattern is expected to recur)

global_verification: V2 Flyway migration applied cleanly at startup (visible in logs).
Soft-deleted post is invisible to GET, GET-list, GET-by-id, PUT, DELETE.
harness.md walked explicitly before commit (retro action item).

parallel_execution_strategy.Round A: 5 of 6 operations are independent file writes/edits to different files -> single function_calls block with 5 invokes. Test file edits can also be parallel.
parallel_execution_strategy.Round B: 2 edits to different files -> single block, 2 invokes.
parallel_execution_strategy.Round D: 1 verify (Bash) then sequential edits then commit.
